summary: Overloaded assertion registrar: dispatches on argument shape to status, body, header, status-array, or custom-function assertions, pushing each as a wrapped closure checked later in assert(). The array-of-statuses form (.expect([200, 404])) was added in 2021 and needed two follow-up fixes the same year for its interaction with JSON bodies and empty-array responses, a real small saga of a feature landing imperfectly and getting corrected in public.
